social_browse_feed.planner_hint: Browse the recommendation feed on your carried phone when you have a social platform activity opportunity.
social_browse_feed.grounder_hint: target_id must be the carried phone from inventory. parameters.limit is optional; use 8 when refreshing a general feed.

social_open_post.planner_hint: Open a visible post from the carried phone's fresh feed context.
social_open_post.grounder_hint: target_id must be the carried phone. parameters.slot selects the feed item; default is 0.

social_comment_post.planner_hint: Comment on a currently visible or open post if your reaction is grounded in the context.
social_comment_post.grounder_hint: target_id must be the carried phone. parameters.text is required; parameters.slot is optional.

social_repost_post.planner_hint: Repost a currently visible or open post if you decide the information is worth sharing.
social_repost_post.grounder_hint: target_id must be the carried phone. parameters.text may contain a repost note; parameters.slot is optional.

social_like_post.planner_hint: Like a currently visible or open post only if you want to register lightweight agreement or attention.
social_like_post.grounder_hint: target_id must be the carried phone. parameters.slot is optional; use the fresh screen context if choosing a feed item.

social_create_post.planner_hint: Create an original post only when recent memories, offline context, or platform content gives you a reason to express a grounded reaction.
social_create_post.grounder_hint: target_id must be the carried phone. parameters.text is required; parameters.tags is optional.

social_exit.planner_hint: End the current social session without a post interaction.
